movelist.name: Bubble Beam
movelist.effect: Bubble Beam lowers the target’s Speed on 18+.

movelist.name: Bug Bite
movelist.effect: If the target has a stored Digestion Buff or has traded in a Digestion Buff this Scene, the user may gain the effects of the Digestion Buff. This does not count towards the usual limit on the user’s Digestion Buffs.

movelist.name: Spider Web
movelist.effect: Spider Web cannot miss. The target is Stuck and Trapped. If the user is freed of the Stuck condition, they are freed of Trapped as well.

movelist.name: Infestation
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.effect: The user resists Fire-Type attacks one step further, is immune to being Burned, and may always act as though in Rainy Weather. Defensive.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Powder Keyword, and does not take damage from any Weather that would normally cause it to take damage. Defensive.
